title_en: Jobs (1/20): A Day in the Life of a Doctor
note_en: 不但……而且…… works like "not only... but also...": 这份工作不但辛苦，而且非常有意义 "this job is not only hard but also deeply meaningful." The subject (这份工作) comes once, before 不但, and is not repeated after 而且. If the two clauses had different subjects, the subject would go after 不但 instead: 不但他去，而且我也去.
